description: Absolute paths of the cluster and of the analyst's computer replaced by variables from config/config.sh (PROJECT_DIR, CODE_DIR, RAW_GENOTYPE_DIR, FASTQ_DIR, TOPMED_PW_FILE); cross-references between scripts renamed to the release layout.

Account and partition replaced by YOUR_SLURM_ACCOUNT / YOUR_PARTITION; log path made relative (logs/); cluster module commands replaced by eval "${CONDA_SETUP}" / "${P7ZIP_SETUP}"; a guard line stops the script if PROJECT_DIR is not set.

A short release header (file, original script, product, how to run) added; every reference to the project's internal analysis log (section numbers) removed; first-person/personal wording and names replaced by neutral terms ('the analyst', 'the original analysis'); the original technical comments were kept below the header.

Hard-coded sample IDs of specific donors (focal, contaminated, excluded, low-level contamination) replaced by environment variables (config.sh; empty by default) so that no donor ID is in the code. With the variables empty these annotations/exclusions are not applied. In 05_PRS/22_prs_analysis.py the set label 'no114_128' became 'main_minus_lowlevel' and two free-text donor notes were removed.
logic_changed: minimal (sets and annotations come from the environment)

description: Private share links of the TOPMed server replaced by variables / a command-line argument.
The list of BAM files is built from the STAR output folders instead of a typed list of the 14 line names (same files, same order).
The final block (variant table, which failed in the original run because of a second 'conda activate') was removed; the same table is produced by 16_variant_table.sbatch.
logic_changed: minimal (no change to the filter itself)

description: os.path.expanduser of a project path replaced by os.environ['PROJECT_DIR'].
Spanish text of an output label translated to English ('coincide' -> 'match', 'DIFERENCIA' -> 'DIFFERENCE'; the comparisons use the same strings).
Names and file labels that identified the group that produced an external reference PRS replaced by 'ExtPRS' / 'extprs' (consistently in the script and its SLURM wrapper).

probe_*, submit_*, run_*, push.sh, scripts that copy files to the analyst's computer (*_pull_*), a report formatter with Spanish output (29b_report_tables.py), early diagnostics of rsID formats (05-07) and the PDF text extraction of the GWAS paper (08), backups (*.bak_*), failed or superseded runs.

description: Comments/titles that named the IDs of a related pair were made generic; a log message of 02_array_pca_report.py that listed four array-ID-to-line pairs was reduced to the IDs given in KEY_CHECK_SAMPLE_IDS.

The statement cm = cm.set_index("IID") had been left inside a comment, so the per-sample contamination estimates were looked up by row position instead of sample ID and the contamination columns of the updated Table S2 were attached to the wrong samples.
